decision_reasoning.final_reasoning_summary: The AutoML pipeline has achieved excellent results on this composition-based classification task. The best model (LightGBM) reaches 0.974 ROC-AUC with minimal cross-validation variance, and four different ensemble methods converge within a narrow band of 0.972-0.974, strongly suggesting the performance ceiling for this feature representation has been reached. The weak_baseline_improvement flag is a false concern — the baseline logistic regression already achieves 0.93, meaning the composition descriptors provide strong linear signal, and the tree-based models successfully capture the remaining nonlinear relationships. With 51 successful trials, no failures, and clear convergence across model families, further iteration would likely yield only marginal gains at significant computational cost.
